secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
secrets.description: Cloudflare account ID — needed for the Workers AI binding (the /api/generate endpoint). Find it in the Cloudflare dashboard under Workers & Pages. Without it the app still boots but AI generation returns 503.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Cloudflare API token with Workers AI permission — needed for the Workers AI binding (the /api/generate endpoint). Create one at Cloudflare dashboard > My Profile > API Tokens. Without it the app still boots but AI generation returns 503.
